Resolves #19698

Both RealWorld apps' API singletons now wait on one shared stored-token promise. Before, they coordinated through a static `Base.on('ready')` / `Base.fire('ready')`, which no class provides: `static observable` applies `Neo.core.Observable` to instances only. Every singleton after the first threw on construction, so neither app could boot, and the middleware's SSR of `/apps/realworld2/index.html` failed its full rebuild.
- `apps/realworld2/api/Base.mjs` `onConstructed()` and `apps/realworld/api/Base.mjs` `onAppRendered()`: the first singleton starts `Base.tokenPromise`, and every singleton chains `onReady` onto it. `initialTokenRequestSent` and both static calls are gone, a net 26 lines fewer.
- The four `params : params` lines in these two files become shorthand. They were pre-existing, but the commit hook scans touched files whole.

Evidence: L2 (a unit arm red on `dev` and a local browser boot of both apps, with and without the fix) → L3 required for the middleware render. Residual: that render, which needs a release and a `pages` bump. Residual-Owner: #19652.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `test/playwright/unit/apps/realworld/ApiToken.spec.mjs`, one arm per app. All five singletons carry `Authorization: Token stored-token`, from exactly one token read. On `dev` both arms fail with the production errors, `Base.on is not a function` and `Base.fire is not a function`. |
| AC-2 | A throwaway local e2e loaded both apps. With the fix, both render with no `Base.on`/`Base.fire` error. On `dev`'s code, RealWorld throws `Base.on is not a function` four times and `Base.fire` once, and RealWorld2 never renders within 30 s. |
| AC-3 | The post-release item below. |

## Deltas from ticket
- RealWorld (v1) is fixed too. It has the identical handshake, deferred into `onAppRendered`. SSR never renders the app, which is why only RealWorld2 failed there.

## Test Evidence
- The arm's poll waits on the token header, not `isReady`. `core.Base` raises `isReady` itself once `initAsync` resolves, so a poll on it passed before the token was read. My first cut of this arm made exactly that mistake.
- `npm run test-unit`: 5042 passed, 2 skipped.
- `check-shorthand`, `check-ticket-archaeology`: 0 violations.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] After the v13.3 release reaches `pages`, the middleware's full rebuild renders `/apps/realworld2/index.html`.
